rule: demonstrations grouped by (skeleton, constants outside the registered signature's types); >1 group and no strict majority group of size >= 2 -> EVIDENCE_CONFLICT (was DEMONSTRATIONS_INCONSISTENT)

within the used group: a slot whose value varies and whose class is not a signature type -> EVIDENCE_CONFLICT (non-parameterizable value; this is what exhausted the parent verifier's counterfactual pool)
frozen_verifier: never called on a conflicting evidence set; not patched
crash_guard: a learner exception is LEARNER_ERROR and counts as VERIFIER_CRASH
